_note: USD per million tokens, list price. Provider prices change: verify before relying on an estimate, and pass --prices <file> to override or add models. A model with no entry here or in --prices makes the run refuse to start rather than be priced at zero. Matching is the exact id, or a dated snapshot of it (<id>-YYYYMMDD or <id>@...); any other variant is unpriced. OpenAI and other providers are deliberately not bundled: supply them with --prices.
